archetypes.name: dyn-stash-gate
archetypes.rationale: Stash preflight changes affect ordering and bypass semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the admission preflight changes around clean-tree and stash checks. Verify dirty-tree failures still win, non-empty or unreadable stash state fails before fetch, and --skip-clean-check bypasses both probes. Check that no raw stash contents can leak into PREFLIGHT_ERROR. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
